No current country-wide food-use ban was confirmed in the regulatory sources checked in 2026.

more_info.overview: Natamycin is a polyene macrolide antifungal substance produced by Streptomyces species. Its preservative role is to limit spoilage caused by microorganisms and extend the storage life of the food. Produced by fermentation with Streptomyces natalensis or other suitable Streptomyces species. The active material is a polyene macrolide antifungal compound. The specified material is supplied as white powder or crystalline material.
more_info.uses:
Examples in the EU food-use list include certain ripened cheese; cheese products; non-heat–treated meat products.
The entries apply to particular food categories and may limit the amount, the preparation or the way it is used; they do not show how often the additive appears in retail products.
